name: boundary and transparent robots
test:
assert find_robots(['O'],[1,1,1,1])==[[0,0]]
assert find_robots(['OO'],[1,1,1,2])==[[0,0]]
assert find_robots(['OO'],[2,1,1,1])==[[0,1]]
print("ok")

name: multiple results and empty
test:
g=['XOXOX']
assert find_robots(g,[1,1,1,1])==[[0,1],[0,3]]
assert g==['XOXOX']
assert find_robots([], [1,1,1,1])==[]
assert find_robots([''], [1,1,1,1])==[]
assert find_robots(['EOE'],[1,1,1,1])==[]
print("ok")
